title.narrative: Reducing the vulnerabilities of Ethiopian migrant returnees and their host communities to the Covid-19 pandemic

description.narrative: The action aims at reducing the vulnerabilities of Ethiopian returnees during COVID-19 upon arrival back to Ethiopia. The action areas are 8 points of entry in four regions namely Galafi and Elidar in Afar; Dawale and Togowuchale in Somali; Metema and Gende Wuha in Amhara; and Humera and Alamata in Tigray.
